# frostmoln_messaging_user (Data Source)

Look up an application user on a managed messaging (LavinMQ) instance by name. It does not expose the password: manage the user with `frostmoln_messaging_user` to read it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The data source never exposes the password: manage the user with
# frostmoln_messaging_user to read it.
data "frostmoln_messaging_user" "billing" {
  instance_id = "51455a51-db3d-4231-ac27-4fee2553c15f"
  name        = "billing-app"
}

output "billing_user_status" {
  value = data.frostmoln_messaging_user.billing.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String) The id of the messaging instance.
- `name` (String) The user's name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the user was created.
- `failure_message` (String) The last failed change's reason in words, or null.
- `failure_reason` (String) The stable code of the user's last failed change, or null.
- `id` (String) The user's id, `<instance_id>/<name>`.
- `status` (String) The user's status: `pending`, `ready`, `deleting` or `error`.
- `updated_at` (String) When the user last changed.
